code = r'''
import xarray as xr, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
p='/data/icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc'
ds=xr.open_dataset(p,engine='h5netcdf')
lat=ds.latitude.values; lon=ds.longitude.values
la=np.where((lat>=54.13-1e-6)&(lat<=55.33+1e-6))[0]; lo=np.where((lon>=14.67-1e-6)&(lon<=15.87+1e-6))[0]
A=ds.analysed_sst.isel(latitude=slice(la[0],la[-1]+1),longitude=slice(lo[0],lo[-1]+1))
b=A.sel(time=slice('1991-12-27','2003-01-05')).load()
t=A.sel(time=slice('2004-06-01','2004-08-31')).load()
bt=pd.DatetimeIndex(b.time.values); tt=pd.DatetimeIndex(t.time.values)
bv=b.values.astype(np.float64); tv=t.values.astype(np.float64)
ny,nx=bv.shape[1:]
def doy_of(ts):
    return np.array([(pd.Timestamp(2000,x.month,x.day)-pd.Timestamp(2000,1,1)).days+1 for x in ts])
pools={d:[] for d in range(1,367) if d!=60}
for Y in range(1992,2003):
    for d in pools:
        m0=pd.Timestamp(2000,1,1)+pd.Timedelta(days=d-1)
        try: B=pd.Timestamp(Y,m0.month,m0.day)
        except ValueError: continue
        w=(bt>=B-pd.Timedelta(days=5))&(bt<=B+pd.Timedelta(days=5))
        pools[d].append(np.where(w)[0])
thr=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan); clim=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan)
for d in pools:
    idx=np.unique(np.concatenate(pools[d]))
    if len(idx)==0: continue
    P=bv[idx]
    thr[d]=np.nanquantile(P,0.9,axis=0,method='hazen')
    clim[d]=np.nanmean(P,axis=0)
thr[60]=(thr[59]+thr[61])/2; clim[60]=(clim[59]+clim[61])/2
def smooth(a):
    arr=a[1:367]; out=np.empty_like(arr)
    for i in range(366):
        ii=[(i+k)%366 for k in range(-15,16)]
        out[i]=np.mean(arr[ii],axis=0)
    return out
thr_s=smooth(thr); clim_s=smooth(clim)  # index i -> doy i+1
tdoy=doy_of(tt)
th=thr_s[tdoy-1]  # (T,ny,nx)
hot=(tv>=th)
# sea cells
sea=np.isfinite(tv).all(axis=0)
print('sea cells',sea.sum(),'thr nan frac in sea', np.isnan(thr_s[:,sea]).mean())
# per-cell MHW
mhw=np.zeros(tv.shape,bool)
T=len(tt)
for j in range(ny):
    for i in range(nx):
        if not sea[j,i]: continue
        h=hot[:,j,i]
        # runs
        runs=[]; s=None
        for k in range(T+1):
            if k<T and h[k]:
                if s is None: s=k
            else:
                if s is not None:
                    if k-s>=5: runs.append([s,k-1])
                    s=None
        # join gaps of 1-2 non-hot days
        merged=[]
        for r in runs:
            if merged and (r[0]-merged[-1][1]-1)<=2 and (r[0]-merged[-1][1]-1)>=1:
                merged[-1][1]=r[1]
            else: merged.append(list(r))
        for a_,b_ in merged: mhw[a_:b_+1,j,i]=True
active=mhw.any(axis=(1,2))
events=[]; s=None
for k in range(T+1):
    if k<T and active[k]:
        if s is None: s=k
    else:
        if s is not None:
            events.append({"onset":str(tt[s].date()),"end":str(tt[k-1].date())}); s=None
print('events',events)
print('active days',active.sum(),'mhw cell-days',mhw.sum())
os.makedirs('output',exist_ok=True)
out=xr.Dataset({'mhw':(('time','lat','lon'),mhw.astype(np.uint8))},
    coords={'time':t.time.values,'lat':t.latitude.values,'lon':t.longitude.values})
out['mhw'].attrs={'long_name':'marine heatwave mask'}
out.to_netcdf('output/mhw_mask.nc')
report={"region":{"lat_min":54.13,"lat_max":55.33,"lon_min":14.67,"lon_max":15.87},
 "baseline_analysed":{"start":"1992-01-01","end":"2002-12-31"},
 "target_analysed":{"start":"2004-06-01","end":"2004-08-31"},
 "events":events,"complete":True,
 "caveats":"Baseline pool uses window days 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 as specified; region cells are the 60x60 subgrid (lat 54.14-55.32, lon 14.68-15.86, dataset coordinates); only the 3301 cells finite on all target days are sea cells; land cells set to 0. Thresholds computed with leap-calendar day-of-year mapping; per-cell MHW joining applied after the 5-day minimum filter."}
json.dump(report,open('output/report.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(report)[:500])
'''
